limitations: The commands were accepted; actual display and authentication/camera activity were not independently captured.
All three runs stopped early; the remaining 100 requested measured frames per trial are unobserved, not passing.
The before/after windows describe timing around a requested event; there is no concurrent no-wake randomized control.
No vendor hardware counters, fence timestamps or per-operation data were collected, so these timings do not isolate TPU execution or preemption.
Reported protocol_pass is false because the requested run did not finish; no separate protocol exception was recorded.
All 600 measured outputs were reported finite and all 220 corresponding captured hashes per trial matched a prior sequence; this is finite-fixture evidence.
Native output-only allocation and experimental async changes were not installed in this production test.
Desk transport and these three attempts do not qualify direct USB or driving.
